Filter a Marker Panel by Data Quality Thresholds

Source: R/filterPanel.R
filterPanel.Rd

Applies a sequential set of data quality filters to a raw marker genotype matrix and its associated genetic map. Filters are applied in a statistically principled order so that each step operates on data already cleaned by the preceding steps:

  1. Map consistency — markers absent from map are dropped; these cannot be placed on the genome.

  2. Marker missingness — markers with a missing rate above miss.marker are removed first, because a failed genotyping assay creates a column of NAs that can make good lines appear more missing than they really are.

  3. Line missingness — lines with a missing rate above miss.line are removed, calculated on the cleaned marker set.

  4. Line heterozygosity — lines with a heterozygosity rate above het.line are removed. Excess heterozygosity typically indicates a mislabelled or contaminated sample. Skipped when het.line = NULL (default).

  5. Marker heterozygosity — markers with a heterozygosity rate above het.marker are removed. High per-marker heterozygosity suggests a paralogous locus or genotyping artefact. Skipped when het.marker = NULL (default).

  6. Duplicate lines — lines with identical genotype profiles are dropped (second and subsequent copies). Performed after quality filters so that clean copies are retained over artefact copies.

  7. Duplicate markers — markers with identical genotype profiles are dropped (second and subsequent copies).

  8. MAF — markers with minor allele frequency below maf are removed last, so that allele frequencies are computed on the fully cleaned dataset.

Usage

filterPanel(
  geno,
  map,
  id = "id",
  map.id = "marker",
  map.chr = "chr",
  map.pos = "pos",
  encoding = "012",
  miss.marker = 0.2,
  miss.line = 0.2,
  het.line = NULL,
  het.marker = NULL,
  dup.lines = TRUE,
  dup.markers = FALSE,
  maf = 0.05
)

Arguments

geno

A numeric matrix (lines x markers) with row names identifying lines, a data.frame with a line identifier column, or a "checkPanel" object from checkPanel. When a "checkPanel" object is supplied the stored geno, map, encoding, and column-name arguments are used automatically and the remaining arguments below need not be specified.

map

A data.frame containing the genetic map. Not required when geno is a "checkPanel" object.

id

Character string naming the line identifier column when geno is a data.frame. Default "id".

map.id

Character string naming the marker column in map. Default "marker".

map.chr

Character string naming the chromosome column in map. Default "chr".

map.pos

Character string naming the cM position column in map. Default "pos".

encoding

Character string specifying the genotype encoding: "012" (default) or "pm1".

miss.marker

Numeric scalar. Markers with a missing rate above this threshold are removed. Default 0.20. Set to NULL to skip.

miss.line

Numeric scalar. Lines with a missing rate above this threshold are removed. Default 0.20. Set to NULL to skip.

het.line

Numeric scalar. Lines with a heterozygosity rate above this threshold are removed (step 4). Excess heterozygosity in a line typically indicates a mislabelled or contaminated sample. NULL (default) skips this filter.

het.marker

Numeric scalar. Markers with a heterozygosity rate above this threshold are removed (step 5). High per-marker heterozygosity can indicate a paralogous locus or genotyping artefact. NULL (default) skips this filter.

dup.lines

Logical. If TRUE (default), duplicate lines are removed (step 6, after quality filters so clean copies are retained).

dup.markers

Logical. If FALSE (default), duplicate markers are not removed. Set to TRUE to drop them (step 7).

maf

Numeric scalar. Markers with minor allele frequency below this threshold are removed. Default 0.05. Set to NULL to skip.

Value

An object of class "filteredPanel" — a list containing:

$geno

Filtered genotype matrix.

$map

Filtered map data frame.

$encoding, $id, $map.id, $map.chr, $map.pos

Carried through for primePanel.

$thresholds

Named list of the threshold arguments used.

$removed

Named list with one element per filter step, each a character vector of the removed line or marker names.

$n.original

Named integer: lines and markers before filtering.

$n.final

Named integer: lines and markers after filtering.

See also

checkPanel, primePanel
